title: Prumo Documentation Lifecycle Registry
description: Canonical deprecation, release-gate and version-policy registry (W20). Declares which version lines current documentation may reference, so "a current document must not present a removed version as available" is machine-checked instead of reviewed by habit.

version.description: The product version this registry describes.

release_gates.description: Human-readable conditions documentation must satisfy before a release.

supported.description: Version lines still supported besides the current one.

deprecated.description: Version lines still narrated but on their way out.

removed.description: Version lines current documentation must not present as available.

historical_exempt.description: When true, documents the authority map classifies as historical may reference removed lines.
